InvestigationRoom.title: InvestigationRoom
InvestigationRoom.description: Authoritative game room synchronization document for a Cluedo investigation session.

hostPeerId.description: Unique peer ID of the detective who opened the manor room

phase.description: Current phase of the match: LOBBY, ROLL, MOVE, SUGGEST, DISPROVE, ACCUSE, or GAME_OVER

lastActivity.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last room action

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last state update

RoomPacket.title: RoomPacket
RoomPacket.description: Real-time communication message or targeted event exchanged between detectives in an investigation room.

senderId.description: Peer ID of the sending detective

targetPeerId.description: Optional targeted peer ID for confidential messages (e.g. disproved card or private hand)

type.description: Type of event: JOIN_REQUEST, JOIN_ACCEPTED, SYNC_REQUEST, SYNC_STATE, PLAYER_STATE, PLAYER_ACTION

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Stores the active game room state and metadata.

/rooms/{roomCode}/packets/{packetId}.description: Real-time messaging subcollection for low-latency cross-network communication between detectives.
